headline: Defienden a exasesor

Yo quién tomo las decisiones soy yo. Ya no está dentro del Gobierno. Nadie es indispensable, los asesores tampoco. Se tocaba al Gobierno a través de su persona», aseveró.  Añadió que, de esa raíz, su exasesor podría defendérselo ante los cuestionamientos de diferentes sectores, y agregó que este ha enviado cartas notariales a quienes lo han, supuestamente, señalado. Además, rechazó que la labor de Villafuerte hubiese tenido qué ver con el Ministerio del Interior u otras instituciones. »Su asesoría era sólo en Defensa.

headline: Del Director
content: La navaja y la verdad. Con el congresista nacionalista Daniel Abú Gallaga, aunado a un grupo de medios y periodistas afines, ha sostenido cómo hipótesis central en el caso López Meneses—that everything was nothing more than a conspiracy by certain political parties and groups seeking to provoke a coup détat. Its a working hypothesis, undoubtedly.  Another hypothesis is what President Ollanta Humala stated yesterday—in declarations to RPP—it wasn’t anything other than police protection services obtained through corrupt practices for someone who needed an appearance of power to profit off influence trafficking.  There exists another work-in-progress theory. Oscar López Meneses would have received police protection—for his house and his father’s—to protect either a person, team of workers, or technological systems related to intelligence and political surveillance. In such conjecture, the support provided by law enforcement wouldve been agreed upon between the protected—or their team—and high government echelons.  As well-known philosopher William of Occam suggested back in the early fourteenth century regarding different explanations about events—the simplest explanation tends to be right. Truthfully speaking, both first and second hypotheses fall short given evidence collected up until now. To put it differently, questions remain unanswered concerning precisely what has happened. With days passing and having already acquired a presidential account, truth becomes increasingly difficult to find.  Its true we dont possess a simple and clear explanation of occurrences; however, there lies quite some distance between suggesting an advance election desire or proposing resignation or impeachment of presidency. We demand greater caution from our authorities along with increased investigation transparency aiming towards uncovering truths. Our democracy deserves no less.
